settings.longBreakDesc: Long break reminder after N minutes of continuous work
settings.idleCutoffDesc: Consider you active if idle < N seconds

settings.aiEnableDesc: Generates a local tip based on your daily stats.
settings.aiEndpointDesc: URL to a local or remote Ollama instance
